title: Prove the sharp 177-term floor for query-using P111 scatters (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with exact finite corroboration. For the fixed PR1525 scatter,
even retaining all eight original centre readouts alongside its puncture-0
query cannot reduce the direct coefficient count. The unique optimum ignores
the query; requiring its use has a sharp one-term penalty.

```text
q = (c61+c63+c31+c256)/2
B(c,q) = S c for every independent centre vector c
minimum nnz(B) = 176
minimum nnz(B), with a nonzero query column = 177
```

All eight constrained minimizers are characterized. The proof covers every
rational coefficient, with the same argument over R and C. Each source row
omits at least two query centres, so any nonzero query coefficient creates
at least two terms, cancels at most two, and adds its own term.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Question source: unpaidmoon
PR6640, Open next question 2. Rohan Arun / rohanarun PR1525 supplies the fixed
query and cut matrix at `90d39a5603c7fbfd8d8d957e9732d9b6ebd6317f`.
Credit JoyboyBrian's earlier triangular identity and the retained
PR1297/1134/1060 lineage. The new result is the universal direct-support
obstruction, not a recheck of their numerical or native results.

## Evidence

- The 176-entry predecessor scatter is the input baseline. The new result
  proves it is uniquely optimal throughout this redundant-readout matrix
  class, and constructs a 177-entry query-using matrix.
- All 112 rows and all 57,344 row/readout-subset cases agree between the
  cancellation optimizer and a separate exact integer-rank oracle.
- The formal endpoint, eight dirty-target basis fixtures, reverse ADD
  restoration, six rejecting controls and a changed-premise positive control
  pass in normal and optimized CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64. Each registered
  command took 0.25 seconds locally.
- Package metadata/source pins, exact committed bytes and source-history
  checks pass at `3aff4f130c8d25a7b35d47f1de2a30ca33a34ba8`.
- Official committed export integrity and input coverage pass. A read-only
  Git-free optimized replay has the identical full receipt, including all
  twelve package-file hashes.

Reproduce from the repository root with the exact local interpreter, or
substitute another CPython 3.12 interpreter. Standard library only.

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/p111-redundant-query-scatter/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/p111-redundant-query-scatter/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p111-redundant-query-scatter
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p111-redundant-query-scatter --check-source-history
```

Expected: `PASS_P111_REDUNDANT_QUERY_SCATTER`,
`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`, and
`PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` with twelve files and two ancestor source pins.

## Limits

All 112 original cut rows must be preserved for every independent centre
vector. A direct matrix coefficient is one scaled ADD; shared intermediate
arithmetic, target mixing, other queries and changed consumer maps are
outside this bound. This is not a general ADD-circuit lower bound.

The ninth readout is an explicit favorable availability grant. Its acquisition,
frames, physical delivery, owner lifetimes, dirty compensation and complete
restoration bill remain unpriced. Native/compiler, precision/tape, all-size
and full supplier obligations remain open. No selected cold replay, Lean or
Docker check was run. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.
Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Related open work

- #6640 prices replacing one centre by this query at the frozen eight-readout
  boundary. This result instead optimizes the redundant nine-readout matrix.
- #1525 supplies the query and leaves a physical continuation open. This
  obstruction covers only its fixed full-cut direct-matrix relaxation.
- #1900 changes both decoder factors through five plane queries; its model
  is outside this single retained-query obstruction.
- #3045 studies fitting-matrix rank floors, which have a different objective
  from this fixed direct-scatter coefficient support.
- #2832 studies global decoder reductions and batching, outside this fixed
  readout dictionary and exact output map.

The completion refresh inspected #6663, #6664 and #6666 through #6675,
the account's twelve other open PRs created since the CLAIM. None studies
this fixed P111 centre query, full-cut scatter or direct coefficient-support
optimum. No additional related-work entry or numerical comparison was needed.

## Open next questions

Can a shared intermediate accumulator exploit the query after acquisition,
frames and restoration are charged? First give one chronological scatter
with the same eight centres and q, then price every readout and temporary.
A physical nine-readout caller is the blocker. A wider matrix search under
the unchanged contract cannot lower the proved support optimum.

## CI notes

Both `plan` and `replay (research/p111-redundant-query-scatter)` passed at
`3aff4f130c8d25a7b35d47f1de2a30ca33a34ba8` in
[run 41670447221](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41670447221).
The completed checks were read once with `gh pr checks`; run metadata confirms
the matching head and successful conclusion. Hosted replay executes both
registered normal and optimized checks. No CI failure was observed. These
execution checks do not establish independent human or proof-kernel review.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Twelve files are added in one scoped
research directory. Shared code, selected records and predecessor files
remain unchanged; the four retained source files and notices are exact copies.
